key_insight: DRBench Pro evaluates deep research reports by measuring structured knowledge breadth and depth, rather than report quality alone.
engineering_relevance: It helps developers identify whether research agents miss major directions or fail to explore related knowledge chains deeply.
method: Build local knowledge trees from Wikipedia.
Sample subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded, relation-level rubrics; agents receive only queries.
Measure breadth and depth, combining them via geometric mean into overall coverage.
evidence_signal: Across 144 cases, 24 domains, 44,102 rubrics, and 16 agents, the best agent achieved 57.04% overall coverage; rubric judgments closely agreed with human annotations, and rankings were stable across tested metric configurations.
watch_item: Wikipedia-derived knowledge trees may underrepresent specialized or emerging research knowledge, limiting generalization to professional research settings.
paper_title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
